text:
The unstable nucleus of an element undergoes radioactive decay. The proton number remains
unchanged.
Which description of this radioactive decay event is correct?
The nucleus emits an α-particle.
A
The nucleus emits a β-particle.
B
The nucleus emits γ-radiation.
C
The nucleus emits an α-particle, a β-particle and γ-radiation together.
D

options.label: D
options.text: The nucleus emits an α-particle, a β-particle and γ-radiation together.
